name: gb
title: Game Boy
description: Gnuboy Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator rebuilt as a current ESPHomeBrew PAX.
author: Gnuboy; P4 port by RetroESP32-P4
about: Runs .gb and .gbc ROMs, including ZIP archives, from /sd/roms/gb/.
controls: Slide-down game menu: Game Boy state slot, save and load.

extract.instructions:
Choose a compatible game ROM you own or a homebrew release, copy it into the folder below, and use Select game in the launcher.

.gb or .gbc (ZIP supported)

FILES / FOLDERS

/sd/roms/gb/* — .gb or .gbc (ZIP supported)

development_note: Development build with shared emulator menu integration; hardware validation pending.
